steps.title: Four steps, at your own pace
steps.subtitle: Nothing to pay, nothing to print, nothing to drop off at an office.

items.title: Create your account
items.body: A phone number, a code sent by WhatsApp. No password to remember.

items.title: Add your CV
items.body: It is read automatically and fills in your file. You correct it, you confirm it.

items.title: Prove your language level
items.body: A one-minute recording. Your CEFR level is estimated — and explained.

items.title: Make your file visible
items.body: German companies find you by trade, language and availability.

credible.title: A file a German employer can verify
credible.subtitle: A CV gets read. A file gets verified. That is the difference between an ignored application and an interview.

items.title: Your diplomas attached
items.body: Every document is attached to your file and opens directly for the recruiter, with no back-and-forth by email.

items.title: Your language level argued
items.body: The level is shown with what justifies it — pace, clarity, duration — instead of simply being asserted.

items.title: A certificate outranks an estimate
items.body: If you provide a language certificate, it is the one that counts. The machine cannot downgrade you.

items.title: Your availability shown
items.body: Immediately, within 1 month or within 2 months: recruiters filter on it and won't contact you at the wrong time.

proof.title: What we can prove
proof.subtitle: No unverifiable promises. Three commitments you can hold us to.

items.title: Declared data processing
items.body: Your personal data is processed under the CNDP framework, and your consent is asked for explicitly.

items.title: Contact released only on request
items.body: Your details never appear in search results. A recruiter has to ask for them, and that moment is timestamped.

items.title: Withdraw at any time
items.body: You can take your file out of the search whenever you want, without having to justify it.

recruiter.title: Hiring in Germany?
recruiter.subtitle: Search by trade, German level, experience and availability. Open the full file. Contact only the profiles you have kept.

points.title: A search that filters on what matters
points.body: Profession, specialisation, minimum CEFR level per language, years of experience, availability, level of education.

points.title: The complete file, on one page
points.body: Education, languages and where each level came from, the spoken assessment with its transcript, the presentation video, openable documents.

points.title: Your pipeline, through to placement
points.body: Saved, contacted, interviewing, placed, rejected — with your private notes and a CSV export.

faq.title: The questions everyone asks
faq.subtitle: Short, honest answers. If anything is unclear, write to us.

items.question: Does it cost anything to sign up?
items.answer: No. Creating your file is free. You pay nothing to be visible to companies.

items.question: Do you guarantee a job in Germany?
items.answer: No, and nobody can seriously guarantee that. We prepare your file and make it visible to German employers; the hiring decision is theirs.

items.question: Who sees my file?
items.answer: Companies registered on the platform, once you have accepted the terms and the processing of your data. You can withdraw your file at any time.

items.question: What happens to my phone number?
items.answer: It is used to sign you in, and it never appears in search results. A recruiter has to request your contact details explicitly, and that request is recorded.

items.question: Do I need to speak German already?
items.answer: Not to start your file. The level required depends on the trade — it is stated on each trade page — and you can keep improving while you build the file.

items.question: How long does the file take?
items.answer: A few minutes for the essentials if you have your CV to hand: it is read automatically and fills in most of the fields. Documents and the spoken assessment can come later.
